top_level.gate_index: int, zero-based query gate; first gate at solve_period
top_level.time: float, capture/request time, solve at time+query_latency for every policy
top_level.budget_remaining: int or null for explicitly unbudgeted dense reference
top_level.max_queries: int, permitted selected active agents at this gate
top_level.agents: list of agent records sorted by agent_id
top_level.switchable_groups: int, currently staged switchable groups within public predicted horizon

agent_fields.current_vertex: str or null, public action occurrence
agent_fields.elapsed: float, elapsed since public current MOVE start; 0 if not active
agent_fields.nominal_duration: float, original author polyline length / 2 metres per second
agent_fields.history_ratio: float, sum delivered END durations / sum corresponding original nominal durations; prior1 if absent
agent_fields.history_count: int, delivered completed MOVE count, 0 if absent
agent_fields.history_variance: float, variance of delivered per-MOVE duration ratios, 0 if absent
agent_fields.history_cv: float, ratio standard deviation / mean, 0 if absent
agent_fields.progress_estimate: float in [0,1], public history/available prior POSITION age model; never truth
agent_fields.last_measurement_age: float or null, now-capture of latest delivered POSITION for current occurrence
agent_fields.last_observed_residual: float or null, original nominal duration*(1-captured progress), not private time-to-complete
agent_fields.measurement_count: int, delivered POSITION count for this agent
agent_fields.downstream_nominal: float, original nominal duration sum for current and future uncompleted actions
agent_fields.outgoing_blocked_agents: int, distinct other agents with unfinished active dependency heads blocked by this current vertex
agent_fields.upcoming_switchable_influence: int, public switchable groups touching this agent within horizon
agent_fields.blocked: bool, staged current vertex whose active author dependencies are unfinished
agent_fields.wait_elapsed: float, elapsed since previous completion/initial0 if current vertex is staged; 0 otherwise

privacy: No case_id, map name/path, family, split, seed, private rates, pauses, future events or true current progress supplied to callback.
override: Simulator.run(policy, probe_override={gate_index: [agent_ids]}); unspecified gates use policy; [] explicitly queries nobody.
reference: DensePositionPolicy explicitly bypasses budget and per-gate cap, querying every active agent; all budgeted policies share both caps.
